messages:
Zoe K: Quick heads-up 1: thinking about a slightly different approach for the routing header shim so SDKs can opt into richer telemetry without leaking tenant PII. Wanted SDK leads to weigh in before I lock the shape.

Harish P: curious what 'richer' means here. we must keep browser header size small.

Zoe K: proposal: two headers, one tiny route token and one opaque meta token. route token is human-readable short (svc=pay;rh=0x3d). meta token is opaque compact blob that console can decode (but not logs). e.g.
```http
X-RW-R: svc=payments;rh=0x3d
X-RW-M: v1:gz:eyJ....  # base64 compacted, contains salted-hash + bucket id
```
SDKs emit only when client opts-in. Console accepts both old routehint and new shim.

Lina M: we like the opaque blob idea; keeps PII out of transit logs. Console will require a version prefix so we can rotate encoding. We'll only accept v1 for 60 days then v2 later. Also need salt rotation notes.

Drew B: For Python/TS/Go SDKs: add client.opts.enable_routing_shim default false. When true: compute salted hash synchronously (truncated) and emit X-RW-M with version tag. Important: redaction in logging util for any header that matches ^X-RW-.*.

Harish P: streaming clients: don't block on an async call to fetch salt. compute locally with salt hint from config or noop. If missing, emit only route token.

Zoe K: telemetry: add sample tag header_scheme=shim|legacy and metric route.header.migration_count. Console will add a dashboard tile showing shim adoption and a mismatch rate (attributed route != billing route).

Lina M: console side needs mapping tools for legal/billing: a gated console-only utility that can resolve the blob to tenant if given salt. This must be audited. We'll document the audit steps.

Drew B: semver plan: minor bump for adding opt-in option. patch bump for logging/redaction util. Include changelog line: "No behavioral changes unless opt-in; headers are redacted from error traces."

Harish P: tests: unit tests for header emission and redaction, integration test against staging ingest showing header_version in samples, and an end-to-end canary with 1% traffic. obs-bot: can you create the alert for plaintext tenant detection?

obs-bot: created monitor "shim_cleartext_tenant" -> alert to #devex-oncall.

Zoe K: rollout suggestion:
- D0: SDK flags + redaction lib in py/ts/go; add changelog and tiny migration playbook (one-liner per step)
- D1: enable in internal staging, console updates to accept shim
- D3: 1% canary (obs monitoring active)
- D8: internal 100% enable; public remains opt-in
- D21: enable by default for new installs, legacy mapping accepted for 60 days

Lina M: we'll add migration tile with exact sample queries for reconciliation and a short blurb explaining why tenant appears hashed.

Drew B: I'll open Python PR tomorrow with redaction tests and the one-page migration playbook. Will include code snippet:
```py
if client.opts.enable_routing_shim:
  headers['X-RW-R'] = short_route(route)
  headers['X-RW-M'] = encode_meta(bucket, sha256(truncate(tenant + salt)))
```
Make sure exception formatting strips these headers.

Zoe K: thanks. please tag me and @Lina on PRs. if the monitor triggers showing plaintext tenant anywhere, rollback immediately. sdk-bot, create a ticket and link owners.

sdk-bot: created RW-8009 "opaque routing shim: SDK opt-in + console decode utility" and added owners.

Zoe K: great. quick ask: keep the opaque blob decode logic only on console backend; never attempt decode in client SDKs. That avoids accidental exposure. :white_check_mark:
